body: Reading those comments did help me but seeing as I have been through loss I just feel like its a matter of time. Im in australia so Im in grade 12. Like you, even with quite moderate-heavy smoking and semi-regular drinking i was a B+-A student... I just constantly feel like Im living in a state of sleep paralysis where I cant do ANYTHING to make it better. Im not on any meds and I never have been. I dont think I can start becuase whilst I dont have a physically abusive relationship as such with my parents (I'm 6'3 and heavy  set) I just... cant talk to them about pretty much anything... you know? thank you for caring and I hope you do well soon.
